name: Leaders, Kings, and Prophets Quiz Bank
summary: Reusable quiz questions from the Leaders, Kings, and Prophets lesson pack.
kid_summary: Questions from Leaders, Kings, and Prophets.

questions.question: What did God tell Joshua to be?
This lesson teaches that god's presence gives courage for new responsibilities.
What happened to Jericho's walls?
This lesson teaches that obedience can look strange, but God's people can trust His instructions.
Who was the judge who helped Barak?
This lesson teaches that god can give wisdom and courage to lead others toward what is right.
What did God promise Gideon?
This lesson teaches that god sees what He can do through us even when we feel weak.
Who did Ruth stay with?
This lesson teaches that faithful love stays near and serves when life is hard.
What did Hannah do with her sadness?
This lesson teaches that prayer is bringing real sadness and hope to God.
What did Samuel say to the Lord?
questions.answer: Speak, for Your servant is listening

questions.question: This lesson teaches that listening to God matters, and even young people can respond to Him.
What does the Lord look at?
This lesson teaches that god sees the heart, not just what people look like outside.
Why was David brave enough to face Goliath?
David defeated Goliath by trusting God, not by copying Saul's armor.
Who was David's loyal friend?
This lesson teaches that true friendship is loyal, truthful, and willing to protect another person.
What did Solomon ask God for?
This lesson teaches that wisdom is better than showing off because it helps us honor God and serve people.
What birds brought food to Elijah?
This lesson teaches that god can provide in surprising ways when His servants depend on Him.
Who answered by fire?
This lesson teaches that the Lord alone is God, and worship belongs to Him.
Where did Naaman wash?
This lesson teaches that humility means receiving God's help God's way.
What did Josiah hear read?
This lesson teaches that god's Word can wake up hearts and call people back to Him.
Who chose to speak up for her people?
This lesson teaches that courage can mean using your place to help people in danger.
What did Job do after terrible loss?
This lesson teaches that god is worthy of trust and worship even when life hurts.
Who is pictured as the shepherd?
This lesson teaches that god cares for His people like a shepherd cares for sheep.
Where did God tell Jonah to go?
This lesson teaches that running from God does not hide us from His care or His command.
Where did Jonah pray from?
This lesson teaches that we can pray to God from the deepest trouble.
What did Daniel resolve to do?
This lesson teaches that faithfulness starts with small choices to honor God.
Who was with the men in the fire?
This lesson teaches that god is able to rescue, and His people can stay faithful even before they know the outcome.
What did Daniel keep doing even after the new law?
God protected Daniel in the lions' den.
What did Nehemiah help rebuild?
This lesson teaches that god's work often takes prayer, planning, courage, and teamwork.
